blockingIssues.description: The vector retriever still uses distance-only ordering inside the vec0 KNN subquery before the inner LIMIT, so tied candidates can drift before fallback tie-breaking runs. That leaves filtered `--ext` searches exposed to unstable top-N selection and possible underfill.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a note that sqlite-vec vec0 KNN queries may reject or ignore secondary ORDER BY keys inside the inner LIMIT. Future tie-stability fixes should verify the SQL shape first and fall back to a probe-and-expand strategy when the engine will not honor the requested inner tie-break.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for fix-search-vector-inner-limit-tie-break found the worker had to abandon the requested SQL shape after vec0 rejected the secondary ORDER BY key, and the remaining blocker still lives in src/db/database.ts before the inner LIMIT.

rejectedObservations.observation: The search-worker skill's tests-first guidance was deviated from during the feature review.
rejectedObservations.reason: Not systemic; this was a justified one-off repro-first deviation for a pure chunker regression and does not warrant a guidance update.

rejectedObservations.observation: The retriever-ranking nuance that vector suffix filters happen after the inner LIMIT while FTS filters before LIMIT is not recorded.
rejectedObservations.reason: Already documented in `.factory/library/search.md`, so no new update was needed.
